nodes.name: index.js
nodes.summary: Entry point for the data_import module. Imports import_preview and data_exporter submodules for side-effects.

nodes.name: db.js
nodes.summary: Client-side frappe.db namespace providing REST wrappers for CRUD and query operations: get_list, exists, get_value, set_value, get_doc, insert, delete_doc, count, get_link_options.

nodes.name: defaults.js
nodes.summary: Client-side frappe.defaults namespace managing user and global default values, user-permission-aware default lookup, and user-permission cache loading from boot.

nodes.name: desk.js
nodes.summary: Desk bootstrap file. Defines frappe.Application class that initializes the Desk UI: realtime, model, nav bar, sidebar, theme, routing, keyboard shortcuts, notices, tours, broadcast listeners, and copy-doc handler. Instantiated via frappe.start_app on DOM ready.

nodes.name: index.js
nodes.summary: DocTypeController base class extending frappe.ui.form.Controller. Handles shared client logic for DocType form and Customize Form: field-type formatters, DB row-size utilization warning, naming_rule/autoname synchronization, max_attachments validation, and fetch_from UI with linked doctype/field selects.

nodes.name: dom.js
nodes.summary: frappe.dom utility namespace: unique id generation, DOM sanitization (remove script/style tags), freeze/unfreeze overlay, CSS injection, element visibility, scroll, pixel measurements, and other DOM helpers used across the Desk.

nodes.name: event_emitter.js
nodes.summary: EventEmitterMixin using jQuery's event system. Provides trigger/on/once/off methods and frappe.utils.make_event_emitter to mix into any object. Default export for ES module consumers.

nodes.name: FileBrowser.vue
nodes.summary: Vue 3 component for browsing server-side files within the file uploader dialog. Supports folder navigation, search, tree view, and selecting existing files to attach.

nodes.name: FilePreview.vue
nodes.summary: Vue 3 component showing a preview row for a queued file: thumbnail/icon, name, size, optimize/private/public toggles, progress bar, and error/remove controls.

nodes.name: FileUploader.vue
nodes.summary: Main Vue 3 file uploader component. Orchestrates drag-and-drop, URL/web-link input, Google Drive picker, image cropper, camera capture, file browser, chunked upload with progress, optimization, and integration with frappe.call for file attachment APIs.

nodes.name: frappe.Application
nodes.summary: Top-level Desk application class. Orchestrates startup sequence: bootinfo, user permissions, nav bar, sidebar, theme, router, keyboard shortcuts, tours, notices, broadcast listeners and copy-doc handler.

nodes.name: frappe.start_app
nodes.summary: Entry point invoked on DOM ready. Ensures frappe.Application is defined, checks assets, provides namespaces, and instantiates the Application.

nodes.name: Application.startup
nodes.summary: Async Desk initialization: waits for translations, initializes realtime and model, loads boot, sets up UI, sets route, triggers startup events, shows notices and setup dialog, emits boot broadcast.

nodes.name: frappe.model.DocTypeController
nodes.summary: Shared controller for DocType and Customize Form client-side logic: fieldtype formatting, naming rule/autoname bidirectional sync, attachment limits, and fetch_from dropdowns.

nodes.name: DocTypeController.setup_fetch_from_fields
nodes.summary: Renders two linked select fields (linked doctype and its field) to let users configure fetch_from on a child row, replacing the default Small Text input.

nodes.name: DocTypeController.naming_rule
nodes.summary: Handler invoked when naming_rule field changes; maps the chosen rule to a default autoname expression and updates the description helper text.

nodes.name: DocTypeController.autoname
nodes.summary: Handler invoked when autoname changes; reverse-derives the naming_rule field value from the autoname pattern (prompt, autoincrement, field:, naming_series:, format:, hash, etc.).

nodes.name: frappe.db.get_list
nodes.summary: Fetches a list of documents via frappe.desk.reportview.get_list with defaults for fields and limit, returning a Promise.

nodes.name: frappe.db.count
nodes.summary: Counts documents matching filters via frappe.desk.reportview.get_count, handling child-table filter distinct detection and optional caching.

nodes.name: frappe.defaults.get_user_default
nodes.summary: Returns a single user default value for key, resolving user permissions and user-permission default doc when applicable.

nodes.name: frappe.defaults.get_user_permission_default
nodes.summary: Picks the active user-permission default for a key: matches current default and overrides with any permission flagged is_default.

nodes.name: frappe.defaults.get_user_defaults
nodes.summary: Returns list of user default values for a key, honoring user-permission scrubbed keys and filtering out values not permitted to the user.

nodes.name: frappe.defaults.get_default
nodes.summary: Returns a default value (JSON-parsed when possible) for a key from user defaults, respecting user permissions.

nodes.name: frappe.dom.remove_script_and_style
nodes.summary: Sanitizes HTML text by stripping evil tags (script, style, noscript, title, meta, base, head) and unsafe link tags using DOMParser.

nodes.name: EventEmitterMixin
nodes.summary: Mixin providing init/trigger/once/on/off methods backed by a hidden jQuery object; default ES module export.
